title: isolepis tenuifolia
intro: Isolepis tenuifolia, commonly known as the slender club-rush or slender spike-rush, is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Isolepis tenuifolia include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
